primary_endpoint: ≥1-stage improvement in fibrosis without worsening of NASH at Week 48; event-free survival at Week 240.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 48, fibrosis improvement occurred in 14.4% with SEL 18 mg, 12.8% with SEL 6 mg, and 12.8% with placebo; p=0.5572 and p=0.9272, respectively. Week 240 event-free survival results were not reported.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 60/354 with SEL 18 mg, 53/351 with SEL 6 mg, and 22/172 with placebo; no deaths in these groups. Open-label SEL 18 mg: 7/23 had serious AEs and 2 deaths.
